mapper.sql: WHERE 1=1AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sale_item i WHERE i.product_id=p.id)AND p.category_id=#{categoryId}AND p.id=#{productId}AND (CONVERT(p.code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) id,p.code,p.name FROM product p ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_suggestion SET status='SUCCESS''FAILURE',content=#{content},error_code=#{code},error_message=#{message},provider=#{identity.provider},model_name=#{identity.model},is_fixture=#{identity.fixture},prompt_tokens=#{usage.promptTokens},completion_tokens=#{usage.completionTokens},total_tokens=#{usage.totalTokens},cached_tokens=#{usage.cachedTokens},provider_request_id=#{usage.requestId},duration_ms=#{duration},finished_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
mapper.sql: WHERE suggestion_type IN #{t} AND (#{user.roleCode}='ADMIN' OR status='SUCCESS' OR operator_id=#{user.id}) AND suggestion_type=#{q.type}AND status=#{q.status} AND (model_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR operator_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%')) AND requested_at>=#{q.startDate}AND requested_at<DATE_ADD(#{q.endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,suggestion_type type,operator_name,period_start,period_end,snapshot_at,provider,model_name,is_fixture fixture,status,requested_at,finished_at,error_message FROM ai_suggestion ORDER BY requested_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) product_id,p.code,p.name,c.name category_name,p.unit,p.stock_qty book_qty,CASE WHEN p.enabled=1 AND p.can_sell=1 THEN COALESCE(b.unexpired_qty,0) ELSE 0 END saleable_qty,p.stock_lower_limit,COALESCE(v.net_qty,0) recent_net_qty,COALESCE(b.near_qty,0) near_qty,COALESCE(b.expired_qty,0) expired_qty,COALESCE(b.near_batch_count,0) near_batch_count,COALESCE(b.expired_batch_count,0) expired_batch_count,b.last_stocked_at LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id,SUM(signed_qty) net_qty FROM v_sale_event WHERE event_at>=#{q.startDate} AND event_at<DATE_ADD(#{q.endDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY product_id) v ON v.product_id=p.id ORDER BY COALESCE(b.expired_qty,0) DESC,COALESCE(b.near_qty,0) DESC,p.stock_qty,(b.first_stocked_at IS NULL),p.id LIMIT 50
